agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor called the regular April 1, 2003 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: CITIZEN PARTICIPATION AND COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Bruno indicated that staff had recently attended a meeting at DRCOG on growth limits and had presented the City of Boulders opposition to expanding regional growth boundaries.

CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION ACCEPTING THE UPDATED WASTEWATER COLLECTION SYSTEM MASTER PLAN.
MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
ECONOMIC VITALITY ACTION GROUP UPDATE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: City Manager Bruno update Council of the current progress of the Economic Vitality Action Group indicating that the group had held their third meeting.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council was copied on lobbying efforts to the RTD, and asked that letters of appreciation be sent to both Dick McLean and Cal Marsala.

agenda_items.title: SELECTION OF CANDIDATES TO INVITE TO INTERVIEW FOR THE CITY ATTORNEY POSITION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: After discussion, candidates A, D, E, and G were unanimously approved as candidates to be invited to interview.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC COMMENT: – NONE
FINAL DECISIONS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to approve consent items 3A through 3D. The motion carried 9:0.

agenda_items.title: SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7270 AMENDING SECTION 4-20-25, “MONTHLY WATER USER CHARGES” AND SECTION 11-1-49, “WATER CONSERVATION MEASURES,” B.R.C. 1981, TO INCREASE THE TREATED WATER QUANTITY CHARGE FOR INSIDE AND OUTSIDE CITY WATER, TO ADD A DROUGHT SURCHARGE, AND SETTING FORTH DETAILS IN RELATION THERETO.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved the modified detached-residential recommendation, 6:3, rejected the Block 1 drought-surcharge amendment, 4:5, and approved leaving commercial rates unchanged pending analysis, 9:0.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTIONS 9-3.2-8, "OCCUPANCY OF UNITS" AND 9-10-4, "CRIMINAL SANCTIONS," B.R.C. 1981, AND TO CLARIFY THE CIRCUMSTANCES UNDER WHICH LANDLORDS AND PROPERTY MANAGERS CAN BE HELD CRIMINALLY LIABLE FOR OCCUPANCY VIOLATIONS AND PROVIDING GUIDELINES AND LIMITATIONS APPLICABLE IN SUCH CASES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: This item was removed from the agenda.

open_comment_speakers.name: Robert Sharpe
open_comment_speakers.topic: Expressed his appreciation for all people who show value for life and support peace and justice. He also raised concerns regarding regional growth and stated disappointment that the city is not taking a stronger stand in opposition to regional growth.

motions.motion_text: candidates A, D, E, and G were unanimously approved as candidates to be invited to interview.
motions.vote_text: After discussion, candidates A, D, E, and G were unanimously approved as candidates to be invited to interview.

motions.motion_text: to accept the staff recommendation for detached residential with the modification to limit the amount of water in Block 1 at 8,000 gallons of average winter consumption including Block 2 and 3 drought surcharges as proposed on agenda item #9, page 7.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried, 6:3, Havlick, Morzel and Riggle opposed.

motions.motion_text: to amend the motion to include the Block 1 drought surcharges on item 9 page 7.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed, 4:5, Corson, Eldridge, Morzel, Ruzzin, and Toor opposed.

motions.motion_text: to leave commercial rates unchanged until results of a Commercial anaylisis is provided later next fall.
BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:43 P.M..
